The same hormones can make hair grow in one area while causing it to thin in another.  Androgens, particularly DHT, can stimulate coarse facial hair growth while shrinking sensitive scalp follicles through a process called follicular miniaturization. This pattern may be associated with androgen excess, PCOS, or increased follicular sensitivity, even when hormone levels are normal. If you’re experiencing facial hair growth, scalp thinning, acne, or irregular periods, consider getting evaluated for hormonal imbalances. #pcos #androgenicalopecia #hairloss #hormonalimbalance #womenshealth
